title: tooling(objectui-readiness 4): paths handed to git use git's cwd-relative forms, so the scripts read the same files under the monorepo's ui/ (objectstack#25728)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoLWbhPgqJMChJC6nv9oFXw1)_

Part of objectstack#25728 (sub-issue 2d of the epic). Part of objectstack#25677.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Why

Standalone, the git repository root is the objectui tree. Under the objectstack monorepo it is one level up, and the tree is `ui/`. Git reads a path in `git show REF:PATH` from the repository root, whatever cwd it runs in, and prints `git diff --name-only` and `ls-tree --full-tree` paths from that root too. On the verification PR objectstack#25718 (run 4) Type Check UI went red at `check:i18n-drift` with `cannot read b77bb37eb2…:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`. The ref was in the clone. The path had no `ui/`.

## The idiom (one, for every script)

It is written down in the header of `scripts/workspace-root.mjs`, section "Paths handed to git". The scripts use git's own cwd-relative forms, not `nestedPrefix()`:

- git runs with its cwd at the tree it judges (`uiRoot()`, or the scratch repository a gate's tests drive it against);
- a path into a revision is `revPath(ref, path)`, which spells `REF:./PATH`. Git resolves `./` against the cwd, so the same spelling names the same file in both layouts;
- a path listing out of `diff` / `diff-tree` / `log` / `show` carries `--relative`;
- `ls-files`, `ls-tree`, `grep` and pathspecs after `--` are already cwd-relative, so they never carry `--full-name` / `--full-tree`.

Standalone each of these is a no-op, because the cwd is the repository root. `nestedPrefix()` was not chosen because it is the workspace's answer: a scratch repository in a test has no `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and git already knows where its cwd sits. The repository already used this form in two places (`check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` and `select-type-check-scope.mjs`).

## Triage

Population: every `scripts/*.mjs` that spawns git. 45 files name git. The census the card cites (31) counted comment mentions too, for example `markdown-test-inputs.mjs` spawns no git at all. Class (a) is a path into git, (b) is a root-relative path out of git, (c) is no path.

| Script | Call | Class | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` | `show REF:packs`, `show REF:designer table` | (a) | `revPath`; plus the base-without-tree rule below |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `diff --name-only` (`changedFiles`, shared by claims and overwrite) | (b) | `--relative` |
| `check-changeset-presence.mjs` | `show REF:manifest`, `show HEAD:changeset` | (a) | `revPath` |
| `check-changeset-claims.mjs` | `ls-tree -r --name-only --full-tree` (`treeIndex`, compared with `ls-files` on the other side) | (b) | drop `--full-tree` |
| `check-changeset-claims.mjs` | `cat-file --batch` input, `show base:file`, `show commit:file` | (a) | `revPath` |
| `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | `show REF:file` | (a) | `revPath` |
| `check-lockfile-integrity.mjs` | `show REV:pnpm-lock.yaml` (cwd = workspace root) | (a), already correct | `revPath` for the one idiom, and its error message |
| `select-affected-tests.mjs` | `diff --name-only base...head` | (b) | `--relative` |
| `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` | `diff-tree --name-only` matched against governed surfaces | (b), on purpose | none. Its subject is the repository root (`AGENTS.md`, `.github/workflows/**`), and under the monorepo the register is objectstack's own (objectstack#25712). Allowlisted with that reason |
| `objectstack-pin.mjs` | `status --porcelain` of the objectstack tree | other repository | none. Already allowlisted, deleted at cutover |
| ls-files callers (`check-bash32-floor`, `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-readme-exports`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `cross-file-line-citation-census`, `dollar-dialect-alias-census`, `census-recorder-wait-shape`, `select-affected-tests` trackedFiles, `coverage-red-cause-census` ls-tree) | `ls-files` / `ls-tree` from the tree | cwd-relative already | none |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `select-type-check-scope` | `--relative`, `REV:./PATH` | already the idiom | none |
| `check-lint-rule-coverage`, `measure-strict-authoring-face`, `objectstack-floor`, rev-parse / merge-base / `cat-file -e` everywhere | `check-ignore`, `grep`, pathspecs, no path | (c) | none |

Tests that spawn git (`scripts/__tests__`, `packages/**`) were read too. Each uses `ls-files`, `grep` or `check-ignore` from the tree, so they are already cwd-relative. The one exception was `bump-objectstack.test.ts`: it ran `show --name-only` and `show HEAD:…` in its scratch repository, and both are now spelled the idiom's way (same answer there).

## A base commit with no objectui tree at all (measured, not in the card)

With the paths fixed, `check:i18n-drift` on the merged layout still went red, and this time correctly. The merge base `b77bb37eb2` is objectstack `main` without `ui/` (`git ls-tree` of it has no `ui` entry and no `packages/i18n`). So the packs are addressed right and are absent there. The PR that imports objectui as `ui/`, and every branch cut from it before it lands, has no before side. `analyze` now asks git whether the tree itself (`REF:./`) exists at the base. Only when it does not is the before side empty, and the CLI prints that ("this tree does not exist at the base commit (the change imports it)…"). The designer table already had the same rule for a missing file. Standalone the tree is the repository root, which exists at every commit, so the rule never fires there. A tree that exists at the base with a pack missing still throws (pinned).

## Regrowth gate

`check:ui-root-lookups` gains two shapes:

- `git-rev-path`: a `show` / `cat-file` argv, or the call that spawns one (so a `cat-file --batch` `input:` is covered), that holds a `REF:PATH` string or template whose path does not start with `./`;
- `git-root-listing`: a `diff`-family argv with a path-listing flag and no `--relative`, or an `ls-files` / `ls-tree` / `grep` argv with `--full-name` / `--full-tree`.

An argv is an array whose head is a git subcommand (after `-C` / `-c` pairs), the string arguments of a `git…`-named wrapper, or a `git …` string command. 20 new self-test cases cover both directions. The header states the bound: argv assembled from names only, rev paths built outside the call, patch-header parsing, `status --porcelain`, and a cwd other than the tree are out of its reach.

**Reverse check.** The new gate, run on the pre-fix tree (`c85408f` with only the gate file replaced), fires at exactly the 15 sites this PR changes, and nowhere else outside the allowlist. The only new allowlisted hit is the governed guard.

## Verification

**objectui standalone** (this branch, after `pnpm run setup`). Every command exited 0:

`pnpm check:ui-root-lookups` · `node scripts/check-ui-root-lookups.mjs --self-test` (37 cases) · `pnpm check:i18n-drift` · `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (no changeset owed: scripts only) · `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` · `pnpm check:changeset-claims` · `pnpm check:lockfile-integrity` · `pnpm check:lockfile-dedupe` · `pnpm check:new-line-citations` · `pnpm check:control-bytes` · `pnpm check:pre-install-import-graph` · `pnpm check:test-path-roots` · `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus` · `pnpm check:lint-rule-coverage` · `pnpm type-check:scripts` · `node scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` · `pnpm exec eslint` over the changed files.

`pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` was run whole in three shards (`--shard=K/3`, under the verify lock): 196 files passed. Two files were skipped by their own `IS_CHILD` conditions (the network-escape worker children).

`scripts/__tests__/git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts` builds a scratch repository of each layout (standalone, and nested under `ui/` beside a file of the monorepo's own) and holds `readPacks`/`analyze`, `changedFiles` (presence and affected-tests), `treeIndex`/`readBlobs` and `collisions` to the same answer in both. Its control is that the root-relative `show` spelling must throw in the nested repository. It also covers the import-commit case. Reverse check: with the five readers reverted to `c85408f`, 4 nested cases fail and every standalone case passes.

**Merged layout.** I used a scratch worktree of the verification branch head `d17ed5edf9` (objectstack#25718: `ui/` imported, adapted and locked) and applied this branch's diff under `ui/` with `git apply --directory=ui`. Then I ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (exit 0) and the CI build of the seven `@objectstack` packages (exit 0). The merge base with `origin/main` resolves to `b77bb37eb2`, the run-4 base.

- Control, before the patch: `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift` exits 1 with `cannot read b77bb37eb2…:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, the run-4 red.
- After the patch, the Type Check UI script chain in CI order exits 0 at every step: `type-check:coverage`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config` and `type-check:e2e`. `check:i18n-drift` reports 3611 en keys added with no before side. The next CI step is the turbo `type-check` over the ui packages, which is not run here (it belongs to objectstack#25727). `type-check:vitest-setup` comes after it in CI and exits 2 locally, because it needs the `@object-ui` builds that step produces.
- The touched scripts reach real verdicts: `check-changeset-presence` (9195 files changed against `b77bb37eb2`, 3 changesets declared, OK), `check-changeset-overwrite` (OK), `check:changeset-claims` (OK), `select-affected-tests --explain` (`mode=full`), `check:ui-root-lookups` (OK). `check:lockfile-integrity` exits 1 with its real verdict, 17 duplications in the merged lockfile. That is the dependency-resolution class of objectstack#25726, not a path error.

## Out of scope

The lucide record-icon list, dependency versions (objectstack#25726), spec drift (objectstack#25727), `.github/**`.
